column1: # partitions_malwarium.csv — 16MB layout with two OTA slots and a dedicated
# NVS partition for the game save.
# nvs/otadata/app0 sit at their STOCK default offsets on purpose: the
# Arduino-ESP32 build script hardcodes boot_app0.bin's target to 0xe000 and
# firmware.bin's default target to 0x10000
# (framework-arduinoespressif32/tools/platformio-build.py) regardless of what
# this CSV says
column2: so moving them silently desyncs the upload from the partition

column1: # table it just wrote — the app then boot-loops (the bootloader looks for app0
# at the table's new offset and finds nothing valid there). Leaving those three
# alone keeps every upload path correct
# THE PARTITION TABLE IS THE ONE THING AN OTA CANNOT UPDATE: the bootloader
# reads it
column2: and an OTA only ever writes into a slot this table already defines.

column1: # Changing anything below requires physical USB access to the board
# device in someone else's hands is frozen on whatever shipped with it. Hence
# the 512KB left unallocated at the end — room to add a future data partition
# without having to resize the app slots (which would move app1 and orphan the
# save). Size the slots generously here rather than reclaiming space later.
# app0/app1 are 0x790000 (7.5MiB) each. The bulk of an image is the compiled-in
# sprite atlas (src/generated/assets.cpp)
column2: so the slot size is what decides how

column1: # long art can keep landing in flash before it has to move to SD.
# `malsave` is a second
# opens a NAMED partition via begin(name
# (config.h's NVS_SAVE_PARTITION; src/platform/esp32/save_store_esp32.h) — so
# the save blob lives here instead of sharing the stock 20KB `nvs` partition
# (which stays default-sized
column2: serving Wi-Fi/BT calibration data as usual).

column1: # 256KB is a ~40x margin over the measured ~6.6KB save blob (v45). No `spiffs`:
# nothing in this codebase uses it (assets are SD_MMC-hosted).
# NVS content is page-based and position-independent
# move between offsets as a raw partition copy:
#   esptool.py read_flash  <old_off> 0x40000 malsave.bin   # before reflashing
#   esptool.py write_flash <new_off> malsave.bin           # after
